question: \(n_1=(1,0,1)\), \(n_2=(1,2,-1)\). What is \(n_1\cdot n_2\)?
solution:
The dot product is the sum of the products of corresponding coordinates:
\[
n_1\cdot n_2=1\times1+0\times2+1\times(-1)=1+0-1=0.
\]
